description: Named, versioned URL-selection presets for source packs (task 434). Generic apparatus filtering is NOT source config: every authority pack wants it, and it should not be restated in each pack's YAML. It also should not live privately in a script. Origin: these rules were defined only inside the authority-packs ingest script (_GENERIC_DENY, _deep), where four packs depended on them and nothing else could reach them. Moving them here makes them data with a schema, per doctrine 4 (scripts are cattle, curated knowledge is stock).
migration_note: The authority-packs ingest script still holds its own private copy of these rules. Until it imports this file, the two are a fork — deliberately recorded here rather than silently created. Filed as follow-up by task 434; the fix is a one-line import, but that file is in another lane's active path and is not touched here.

generic-apparatus.description: Site furniture that is never an authoritative document: search, login, feeds, calendars, contact and legal boilerplate. Multilingual (de/fr/it) because AW's targets are.

min_path_segments.description: A URL with fewer than N path segments is a section landing page, not an item. Evidence (smoke run 2026-08-07, recorded in the authority-packs ingest script (_deep)): https://www.iea.org/analysis — the bare section hub — extracted 84 passages of pure navigation furniture. Packs override per route where a source genuinely publishes items at depth 1.
